channel.title: The Global Meridian – International News Wire
channel.description: Authoritative, verified global journalism from international news bureaus across London, Brussels, Washington, Dubai, Moscow, Beijing, Tokyo, Seoul, New Delhi, and Nairobi.

item.title: COP31 Climate Summit Collapses in Antalya Without a Final Pact, First UN Breakdown Since 2009 Copenhagen
item.description: After stretching two days past deadline into bitter overtime, UN COP31 negotiations in Antalya, Turkey ended in historic failure with no final overarching pact after oil-producing states blocked fossil-fuel phaseout language and the European Union and island nations rejected the diluted text.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Ukraine Drone Strike Hits Russian Navy Corvette Merkury and Arms Freighter Off Libya’s Benghazi Coast
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Ukrainian drone strikes hit Russian military shipping after satellite imagery showed the Russian Navy corvette Merkury and an equipment cargo vessel badly damaged near Benghazi, Libya, even as weekend Russian barrages killed 15 in the Kyiv region.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: NYT Report Deepens Nvidia Scandal Over Chinese Intelligence Contact and Illicit AI Chip Smuggling Probe
item.description: Fresh disclosures in The New York Times reveal Alice Huang—at the center of former Nvidia chief Jensen Huang’s resignation crisis—maintained over a year of direct contact with a Chinese Ministry of State Security officer as U.S. intelligence probes alleged AI chip smuggling via Megaspeed International.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Oxfam and Environmental Monitors Warn Over 99% of Gaza’s Land and Water Is Now Contaminated
item.description: A landmark report released November 23 by Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory (CEOBS) warns that over three years of bombardment and collapsed sanitation have poisoned more than 99% of Gaza’s soil and water sources, threatening 2.3 million residents for generations.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Asian Tech Stocks Slide as KOSPI Drops 4%, While Gold Rebounds Above $3,625 and Bitcoin Reclaims $60,000
item.description: South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI fell roughly 4% on Monday alongside losses in Hong Kong and Brent crude near $92.29, while spot gold jumped back toward $3,630 per ounce and Bitcoin climbed above $61,000 following last week’s liquidity squeeze.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Max Verstappen Wins Las Vegas Grand Prix From Pole to Hand Red Bull Ford Historic First US Victory
item.description: Max Verstappen converted pole position into a commanding victory under the Las Vegas Strip lights, delivering Red Bull Ford Powertrains its landmark first Formula 1 triumph on American soil and Ford’s 180th all-time F1 race win.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz Defeats World No. 1 Alexander Zverev in Turin to Capture Maiden ATP Finals Crown
item.description: Spanish star Carlos Alcaraz defeated top-ranked Alexander Zverev 6–2, 7–6 in Turin to lift his first career ATP Finals trophy, sealing an emphatic indoor hard-court run.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Russian Cargo Vessel Sparta II Struck by Drones Near Gulf of Finland, Forcing Crew Rescue Operation
item.description: Finnish maritime authorities launched an emergency evacuation and rescue operation after the Russian cargo ship Sparta II was struck by drones near the Gulf of Finland amid sweeping overnight missile and drone strikes across Ukraine.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: SpaceX Dragon Splashes Down Off Los Angeles Carrying Over 6,300 Pounds of Bioprinted Blood Vessels and Cancer Organoids
item.description: An unpiloted SpaceX Cargo Dragon spacecraft undocked from the International Space Station and splashed down safely in the Pacific off Los Angeles, delivering over 6,300 pounds of microgravity medical breakthroughs back to Earth.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: COP31 Climate Talks Crash Into Second Day of Overtime in Antalya as Draft Drops Fossil-Fuel Phaseout
item.description: Negotiators from nearly 200 nations battled through a second day of weekend overtime at COP31 in Antalya, Turkey after a revised presidency draft stripped explicit references to phasing out fossil fuels amid Washington’s diplomatic absence.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Mexican Forces Capture FBI Most-Wanted Cartel Boss “El Chapo Isidro” in Sinaloa Military Raid
item.description: Mexican security forces arrested high-profile narcotics kingpin Fausto Isidro Meza Flores—known as “El Chapo Isidro” and listed among the FBI’s most wanted fugitives—during a coordinated military raid in Sinaloa.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Thousands March Through Pouring Rain in Lisbon as Cost-of-Living and Housing Protests Ripple Across Europe
item.description: Carrying umbrellas and union banners along Lisbon’s central boulevards on November 21, thousands of Portuguese workers demanded living wages and affordable housing as similar labor and youth demonstrations swept France, Spain, Italy, and the UK.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: India Smash Record 720-9 Declared in Wellington as Rishabh Pant Blazes 128 Against New Zealand
item.description: India piled up 720-9 declared at Wellington’s Basin Reserve—both their highest-ever overseas Test score and the highest Test innings total ever recorded in New Zealand—fueled by Rishabh Pant’s 128 before New Zealand closed Day 4 on 119-2.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Newcastle Hold Arsenal 2–2 at St James’ Park as Leeds Stun Chelsea 4–1 in Dramatic Premier League Weekend
item.description: Arsenal rescued a point through Noni Madueke’s late equalizer in a pulsating 2–2 draw at Newcastle United, while Leeds United shocked Chelsea 4–1 and Fulham held Manchester City 1–1 across Matchday 11.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Russian Missiles and Drone Breach Polish Airspace During Ukraine Barrage, Prompting NATO Jet Scrambles
item.description: Three Russian aerial objects—including a Kh-101 cruise missile near Nowy Lipowiec and a suspected jet drone near Mołodycz—crossed into southeastern Poland during a massive overnight strike on Ukraine, prompting Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk to warn of an intentional provocation as allied F-16s scrambled.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Nasdaq Plunges Over 5% Into Correction Territory as Post-IPO Anthropic Slide Triggers AI Valuation Reckoning
item.description: Wall Street suffered its steepest tech sell-off of the year as the Nasdaq Composite tumbled more than 5%, wiping out 2026 gains while newly listed Anthropic surrendered early post-debut advances and major US benchmarks slid into correction territory.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Bitcoin Slides Toward $56,000, Wiping Out Post-Election Gains Amid Heavy Spot ETF Outflows and Liquidations
item.description: Cryptocurrency markets suffered a sharp risk-off unwind as Bitcoin dropped roughly 20% in November toward the $56,000 threshold—erasing its entire post-election rally amid billions in U.S. spot ETF redemptions and forced derivatives liquidations.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: LPG Tanker Tara Gas and Commercial Vessels Struck Near Strait of Hormuz Off Khasab, Triggering Crew Rescue
item.description: Maritime rescue units evacuated injured crew members to Khasab, Oman after the Panama-flagged LPG carrier Tara Gas—crewed largely by Indian sailors—and other commercial tankers were struck by projectiles or mines along the Strait of Hormuz.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Nvidia Extends Steep Sell-Off Amid Reported SEC Accounting Probe and Leadership Transition Uncertainty
item.description: Shares of AI semiconductor bellwether Nvidia slid heavily, deepening a multi-week drawdown that has erased trillions in market capitalization following reports of a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission accounting probe and post-transition uncertainty.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: India and Japan Seal Historic Tokyo 2+2 Pact Allowing JSDF Live-Fire Missile Drills on Indian Soil
item.description: At the Fourth India-Japan 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministerial in Tokyo, ministers signed a landmark Letter of Intent enabling Japan Self-Defense Forces to conduct surface-to-ship missile live-fire drills at Indian ranges alongside deeper naval tech co-development.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Ronaldo Nets 986th Career Goal Before Striking Post From the Spot as Al Ahli Rally 3–1 Past Al Nassr
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo volleyed home his 986th career goal in Riyadh before hammering a 19th-minute penalty off the left upright—his second consecutive Saudi Pro League spot-kick miss—allowing Al Ahli to storm back for a 3–1 victory.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: ICJ Delivers Historic Verdict Ruling Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya
item.description: In a landmark merits judgment at the Peace Palace in The Hague, the International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar violated the Genocide Convention through military atrocities against the Rohingya population, sparking celebration in Cox’s Bazar refugee camps.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Severe Cyclone Akvan Nears India’s East Coast, Prompting Mass Evacuations and Rail Suspensions
item.description: Tens of thousands of coastal residents were evacuated across Odisha and Andhra Pradesh as Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan intensified over the Bay of Bengal, forcing port closures and widespread cancellation of East Coast passenger trains.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: US and Thailand Seal Landmark 99% Tariff-Free Trade Deal Alongside HIMARS Defense Package
item.description: Washington and Bangkok finalized a sweeping bilateral trade accord eliminating duties on 99 percent of traded goods alongside a defense procurement package featuring US HIMARS rocket artillery systems.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Houthi Missile Strike Hits Riyadh’s Public Investment Fund Tower Amid Escalating Gulf Hostilities
item.description: Saudi authorities reported that a long-range missile attributed to Yemen’s Houthi movement struck Riyadh’s PIF Tower in the King Abdullah Financial District, heightening regional air-defense alerts and energy market nerves.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Over 150 Nations and $4 Trillion Corporate Coalition Launch Global Electrification Package as COP31 Closes
item.description: As UN climate talks wrap up in Antalya on Friday, more than 150 governments representing two-thirds of global GDP and over 260 corporations launched a sweeping electrification package targeting clean grids and zero-emission transport corridors.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Bangladesh Garment Hub Protests Disrupt Factories Over ৳30,000 Minimum Wage Demand
item.description: Garment workers across Dhaka, Gazipur, and Narayanganj staged mass demonstrations and highway blockades demanding a ৳30,000 monthly minimum wage, triggering security clashes and temporary shutdowns across major export corridors.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: EU Mobilizes €24 Billion Under STEP Tech Platform as Economists Debate Data Center Bubble Risks
item.description: The European Commission highlighted €24 billion mobilized across deep tech, clean tech, and defense under its STEP initiative, even as Western governments fast-tracking AI data centers face mounting warnings over capacity bubbles and grid strain.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin Open Unprecedented Trilateral Talks at Shenzhen’s Kylin Villa
item.description: US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened at Shenzhen’s Kylin Villa resort on Thursday for historic three-way talks focused on nuclear arms stability, major conflicts, and great-power crisis channels.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Anthropic Prices Record $81.3 Billion Nasdaq IPO at $83 a Share, Surpassing SpaceX
item.description: Frontier AI developer Anthropic priced its blockbuster initial public offering above its marketed range at $83 per share, raising $81.3 billion to claim the largest IPO in global market history at an implied $1.5 trillion valuation.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Campaign Cuts Russian Oil Refinery Processing by 45% Since Late October
item.description: Industry figures compiled by Reuters show sustained Ukrainian deep-strike drone and missile barrages have slashed Russian crude refining volumes by nearly half, coinciding with renewed strikes on the Kerch Bridge.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Israeli Troops Cross Central Gaza ‘Yellow Line’ in New Ground Operation, Displacing Families
item.description: Israeli armored units pushed past the ceasefire demarcation line into central Gaza on Thursday, uprooting displaced families into flooded winter encampments just hours after UN monitors warned the year-old truce is near collapse.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Netanyahu Presses Washington to Back Airstrikes on Iran as White House Weighs Intelligence
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has urged the Trump administration to endorse a multi-day air campaign against Iranian facilities after transmitting new intelligence allegations, prompting intense debate inside Washington national security circles.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Nvidia Q3 Revenue Doubles to $115.8 Billion as Board Rules Out Rehiring Former CEO Huang
item.description: Nvidia posted 103 percent year-on-year revenue growth to $115.8 billion and guided fourth-quarter sales near $130 billion, while directors confirmed the chipmaker is moving permanently forward without former chief executive Jensen Huang.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: IEA Warns Global Data Centers Will Drive 70% Surge in Carbon Emissions by 2030 Amid AI Boom
item.description: A stark International Energy Agency assessment cautions that explosive artificial intelligence electricity demand in the United States and China is delaying coal and gas plant retirements and reversing corporate decarbonization timelines.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: UN Report Finds One in Four Women Globally Lack Power to Refuse Marital Sex, With Stark African Gaps
item.description: A landmark UN Population Fund study reveals that 25 percent of partnered women worldwide cannot refuse sex within marriage, with the figure rising to 45 percent in West and Central Africa and prompting calls to enforce the Maputo Protocol.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Manchester United Dismisses Michael Carrick After 4-4 Villa Draw as Pochettino Leads Successor Odds
item.description: Manchester United parted ways with head coach Michael Carrick following a turbulent start to the Premier League campaign, with US Men’s National Team manager Mauricio Pochettino emerging as the leading candidate for Old Trafford.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Netflix and Fox Brace for $2 Billion Bidding Clash Over US Broadcast Rights to 2030 FIFA World Cup
item.description: Streaming powerhouse Netflix and incumbent broadcaster Fox are preparing rival bids approaching $2 billion for English-language US media rights to the centenary 2030 FIFA World Cup across three continents.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Xi Breaks Diplomatic Protocol to Greet Trump on Shenzhen Tarmac Ahead of Historic APEC Talks
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping personally welcomed US President Donald Trump at Shenzhen Bao’an International Airport on Wednesday, setting an unusually warm opening tone ahead of high-stakes bilateral trade talks and an anticipated three-way summit with Russia’s Vladimir Putin.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: US-Backed Board of Peace Warns UN Security Council That Gaza Ceasefire Faces Imminent Collapse
item.description: In a stark briefing to the UN Security Council, the international Board of Peace cautioned that stalled civilian governance transfers, delayed border approvals, and severe winter shelter shortages threaten to unravel the year-old Israel–Hamas truce.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Anthropic Prepares Historic Nasdaq IPO Pricing Near $1.5 Trillion Valuation as AI Markets Face Litmus Test
item.description: Artificial intelligence developer Anthropic is set to price its blockbuster Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT on Wednesday after institutional demand pushed implied valuations toward $1.4 trillion to $1.6 trillion.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: NATO Allies Commit £240M Winter Air-Defense Surge at 37th Ukraine Contact Group Meeting
item.description: Defense chiefs convening in Brussels under NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte unveiled fresh air-defense missiles, radar batteries, and European procurement funds to shield Ukraine’s energy grid through winter.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Nvidia Beats Quarterly Revenue Forecast as Global Tech Markets Weigh Post-Huang Transition
item.description: Chipmaker Nvidia posted stronger-than-expected quarterly sales and data-center guidance, helping Asian semiconductor equities stabilize even as institutional investors scrutinize leadership succession and sovereign AI spending.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: COP31 Enters Final Stretch in Antalya With Fresh $200M Pledge Amid Climate Finance Deadlock
item.description: As UN climate negotiations in Antalya enter their decisive closing days, a coalition of donor nations pledged $200 million for adaptation funds while major economies clashed over public climate finance and warning signs of planetary tipping points.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Severe Winter Smog Engulfs Northern India’s Indo-Gangetic Plain, Triggering Emergency Health Alerts
item.description: Toxic winter haze driven by temperature inversion, vehicle emissions, and seasonal crop-residue burning pushed air quality into hazardous territory across New Delhi, Haryana, and Punjab, prompting school restrictions and hospital advisories.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Mirra Andreeva Sweeps to Maiden WTA Finals Crown at Indian Wells, Rising to World No. 2
item.description: Teenage sensation Mirra Andreeva defeated Elina Svitolina in straight sets without dropping a single set all week to capture the 2026 WTA Finals singles title and become the youngest champion since Maria Sharapova in 2004.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: EU and Australia Sign Landmark Horizon Europe Association Pact for Joint Scientific Research
item.description: Brussels and Canberra formally signed Australia’s association to Pillar II of the €52.4B Horizon Europe framework, granting Australian researchers and deep-tech consortia equal leadership footing starting January 2027.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Quad Leaders Unveil Indo-Pacific Maritime Security and Undersea Cable Pact in Manila
item.description: US President Donald Trump joins India’s Narendra Modi, Japan’s Sanae Takaichi, and Australia’s Anthony Albanese in Manila to expand real-time maritime surveillance, subsea cable defense, and critical-mineral supply frameworks.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Overnight Missile and Drone Strike Collapses 227-Meter Span of Crimea’s Kerch Bridge
item.description: An overnight Ukrainian multi-wave missile and drone operation severed a major road arch of the strategic Kerch Bridge linking mainland Russia to occupied Crimea, forcing a halt to rail and highway traffic.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: South Korea’s KOSPI and Japan’s Nikkei Slide on AI Export Curbs and Chip-Sector Volatility
item.description: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Japanese semiconductor equipment makers dragged Asian benchmarks sharply lower as US Commerce curbs on offshore AI clusters and mega-IPO capital shifts rattled investors.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: EU Widens Russia Sanctions to Target Wildberries CEO Tatyana Kim and Nearly 50 Banks
item.description: The Council of the European Union approved a broad mid-November sanctions package targeting more than 100 entities, major financial institutions, and Russian e-commerce logistics figures accused of supporting defense supply chains.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Leonid Meteor Shower Peaks as Astronomers Warn Satellite Mega-Constellations Threaten Dark Skies
item.description: Skywatchers across both hemispheres await the peak of the annual Leonid debris stream from Comet Tempel-Tuttle, even as observatories report growing orbital light streaks obscuring faint meteors.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Global Gaming Industry Braces for ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Launch After Record Digital Pre-Loads
item.description: Broadband operators, console makers, and entertainment publishers prepare for massive network spikes as Rockstar Games readies Grand Theft Auto VI for its November 19 release on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Ten Nations Sign ‘San Francisco Declaration’ to Protect AI and Semiconductor Supply Chains
item.description: Under the US-led Pax Silica initiative, ten allied economies established five working groups covering critical minerals, advanced fabs, energy grids, and compute infrastructure, even as protests hit a planned Philippine tech hub.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Estonia Orders Full Closure of Russian Border Crossings After Foiling Alleged GRU Sabotage Plot
item.description: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna announced all crossing points with Russia will shut on December 1 after internal security officers arrested eight suspects accused of planning arson against drone maker Threod Systems.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: US Bolsters Middle East Naval Posture After Drone Interceptions Over Bahrain Bases
item.description: US Central Command and Bahraini air-defense batteries intercepted Iranian one-way attack drones targeting radar and military sites near Sheikh Isa and Al-Riffa as additional naval strike assets repositioned across the Gulf.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: COP31 Talks in Antalya Enter Critical Final Week Over 35% Global Electrification Target
item.description: Under Turkey and Australia’s joint presidency, COP31 negotiators clash over draft language accelerating fossil-fuel phase-downs and scaling global clean electricity to 35% of final energy demand by 2035.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Finland’s ICEYE Unveils Gen5 11-Centimeter AI Radar Satellites for All-Weather Imaging
item.description: European space leader ICEYE introduced its fifth-generation synthetic aperture radar constellation capable of 11-centimeter defense imaging, doubled orbital capture volume, and onboard AI target screening.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: UEFA Nations League Tightens as Germany and the Netherlands Renew Rivalry Ahead of Finals
item.description: Heavyweight European football nations finalize squad rotations and tactical adjustments in Amsterdam and Munich as Nations League group fixtures enter decisive matchdays.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: SK Hynix Accelerates Yongin Cluster Expansion With ‘Trinity Fab’ AI Memory Supplier Hub
item.description: South Korea’s SK Hynix is speeding up multi-trillion-won cleanroom construction in Yongin south of Seoul, anchoring a dedicated equipment-testing fab to expand High Bandwidth Memory output.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Japan’s Economy Contracts 0.1% in Third Quarter as Inflation Restrains Household Spending
item.description: Preliminary Cabinet Office data showed Japan’s real GDP shrinking at an annualized 0.1% pace in July–September, snapping three quarters of growth amid sticky food prices and softer net exports.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: South Korean Foreign Minister Meets Wang Yi in Beijing Ahead of APEC Summit
item.description: South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun held wide-ranging consultations with Chinese counterpart Wang Yi in Beijing to prepare leadership talks and urge constructive Chinese diplomacy on the Korean Peninsula.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Namdaemun Market’s Viral ‘Scarf Man’ Draws International Visitors to Historic Seoul Stall
item.description: A modest stallholder in Seoul’s 600-year-old Namdaemun Market selling six scarves for 10,000 won has sparked a global social-media sensation with his deadpan reverse-psychology sales banter.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Modi Anchors 23rd ASEAN–India Summit With Maritime Security and Supply-Chain Agenda
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the 23rd ASEAN–India Summit and 21st East Asia Summit in Manila, championing maritime cooperation, rules-based navigation, and tariff modernization.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: China Courts European and Canadian Trade Partners Ahead of Shenzhen APEC Hosting
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping and senior commerce envoys intensified bilateral trade outreach to Ottawa and European capitals ahead of APEC, pitching tariff stability and clean-tech market access.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: US Aviation Recovers After Four-Hour FAA Nationwide Ground Stop Disrupts Thousands of Flights
item.description: Airlines cleared lingering crew and aircraft backlogs across major US hubs following a rare 4.5-hour Federal Aviation Administration departure halt triggered by an air-traffic telecom failure.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: India Edges New Zealand by 22 Runs at Mount Maunganui to Seal 3–1 ODI Series
item.description: Disciplined death-overs bowling sealed India’s 22-run victory over New Zealand in the fifth and final ODI at Bay Oval, capping a clinical 3–1 white-ball series triumph.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Brazil–China Bilateral Trade Surges to $143.3 Billion as Brasília Diversifies Beyond US Tariffs
item.description: Nine-month Brazil–China commerce jumped over 11% to $143.3 billion in 2026, with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva highlighting expanded Asian export demand as a cushion against US trade duties.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Cursor Supply-Chain Breach Exposes AI Developer Tooling Risks After Trojanized Extension
item.description: AI code editor Cursor disclosed a multi-stage security incident stemming from a compromised Fireworks AI vendor credential that culminated in a malicious extension upload before rapid cloud remediation.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Britain Sanctions West Bank Settlement Builders and Gaza Aid Blockaders Amid Winter Storms
item.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband imposed asset freezes on eight Israeli construction firms and activist group Tzav 9 as torrential rains flooded makeshift displacement camps across Gaza.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Shipping Alerts Escalate Amid Tanker Security Incidents and Closure Warnings
item.description: Maritime risk advisories spiked across the Persian Gulf after Tehran issued closure warnings in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting Oman and Qatar to mediate urgent shipping de-escalation.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Reaches Historic One Light-Day Milestone 25.9 Billion Kilometers From Earth
item.description: Nearly half a century after its 1977 launch, NASA’s interstellar pioneer Voyager 1 reaches 25.9 billion kilometers from Earth—requiring a full 24 hours for radio commands traveling at light speed.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Mercedes Clinches Ninth Formula One World Constructors’ Championship After Strategic Victory
item.description: Brackley’s Mercedes works team sealed its ninth Formula One World Constructors’ crown after flawless wet-dry tire strategy and double-points consistency through the autumn flyaway races.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: WHO Calls for Expanded Neonatal Intensive Care Ahead of World Prematurity Day 2026
item.description: Marking World Prematurity Day, WHO and pediatric partners urged governments to widen access to continuous positive airway pressure, kangaroo mother care, and regional NICU staffing for 15 million annual preterm births.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Climate Consortia Deploy High-Resolution AI Weather Emulators to Cut Grid Forecast Delays
item.description: University researchers and meteorological agencies are deploying physics-informed AI climate emulators that cut severe storm and heatwave simulation runtimes from weeks to minutes for power grid operators.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Japanese Blockbuster ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ Surges Past Global Box-Office Milestones
item.description: Toho’s follow-up kaiju feature has shattered international autumn box-office expectations across North America, Europe, and East Asia, underscoring sustained appetite for non-English theatrical spectacles.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: US-Mediated Trilateral Talks in Abu Dhabi Yield Agreement on Large Ukraine–Russia Prisoner Swap
item.description: Senior American, Ukrainian, and Russian delegations wrapped up intense closed-door negotiations in the United Arab Emirates with an agreement in principle for a major prisoner-of-war exchange despite unresolved territorial gaps.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Africa CDC Expands Cross-Border Ebola Containment and Mobile Sequencing in Central Africa
item.description: Health authorities across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring transit hubs deployed mobile genomic laboratories and ring-vaccination teams to contain a stubborn six-month outbreak.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Federal Reserve and Bank of England Weigh Sticky Energy Costs Against AI Capital Spending
item.description: Central bankers in Washington, London, and Frankfurt signaled patience on further rate cuts as maritime energy shipping premiums collide with surging industrial data-center investment.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Commercial Satellite Imagery Tracks New Underground Excavation at Iranian Missile Complexes
item.description: High-resolution orbital and radar scans reveal fresh tunnel reinforcement, blast berms, and logistics aprons at strategic Iranian ballistic-missile and launch sites.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Millions Join Spain’s First General Strike in 14 Years Over Soaring Rents and Evictions
item.description: Trade unions and tenants’ movements staged a 24-hour nationwide strike on November 11 under the banner “Salaries, Housing, Prices,” forcing emergency anti-eviction legislation ahead of snap elections.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Analysis: How Central Asia’s Middle Corridor Is Redrawing Eurasian Trade Logistics
item.description: Digital customs harmonization, Caspian port expansions, and European infrastructure backing are turning the Trans-Caspian corridor from a backup rail line into a permanent Eurasian artery.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: US, China, and Russia Confirm First-Ever Trilateral APEC Summit in Shenzhen for Nuclear Talks
item.description: Washington, Beijing, and Moscow finalized plans for an unprecedented November 19 trilateral summit in Shenzhen focusing on strategic arms stability, trade friction, and regional de-escalation.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: WMO Warns at COP31 Antalya That Record Ocean Heat Is Driving Prolonged Weather Extremes
item.description: Presenting its 2026 climate state assessment in Antalya, the World Meteorological Organization warned that unprecedented upper-ocean heat content has locked in stronger storms, marine heatwaves, and erratic monsoons.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: OECD Projects 2.9% Global Economic Growth in 2026 Backed by Industrial Capex and Services
item.description: In its Paris interim economic outlook, the OECD projected steady 2.9% global expansion led by North American and Asian industrial capital spending, while flagging high sovereign debt servicing costs.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Automakers and Logistics Giants Scale ‘Physical AI’ Robotics Across Automated Factories
item.description: Multimodal vision-language-action models are moving off cloud chat interfaces into dexterous factory manipulators, warehouse sorters, and high-voltage grid inspection robots across Japan, Germany, and the US.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Direct Lithium Extraction Piloting Cuts Freshwater Footprints Across Battery Supply Chains
item.description: Commercial-scale direct lithium extraction plants in South America and North America are recovering battery-grade lithium from geothermal and salt-flat brines without vast evaporation ponds.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: EU Defense Ministers Boost European Defence Agency Budget and Approve Eight Joint Priorities
item.description: Meeting under High Representative Kaja Kallas in Brussels, EU defense chiefs raised the European Defence Agency’s 2027 budget by 8.7% to €78M and greenlit joint missile, air-defense, and space early-warning programs.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: CAF U-23 Africa Cup Qualifiers Enter Decisive Knockout Ties Across Nairobi and Rabat
item.description: Emerging African football powerhouses battle through home-and-away U-23 continental qualifiers, showcasing homegrown academy midfielders eyeing European transfers and Olympic pathways.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: International Film Festival of India Unveils 159-Title Global Slate Ahead of Goa Opening
item.description: Curators for the 57th International Film Festival of India finalized a 159-film international showcase in Panaji spanning European, Asian, African, and Latin American co-productions alongside Film Bazaar market labs.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: UN Adaptation Finance Facility Secures $120 Billion Grant Window for Coastal and River-Basin Nations
item.description: Multilateral development banks and donor governments agreed on grant-backed climate adaptation rules channeling concessional resilience funding toward flood-prone coastal cities and African river basins.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: ITU Advances Sub-Terahertz Spectrum Framework for Direct-to-Cell 6G Satellite Networks
item.description: Telecom regulators in Geneva agreed on interference-protection guidelines for sub-terahertz satellite-to-terrestrial 6G links, paving the way for seamless rural broadband coverage.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: India and ASEAN Launch $42 Billion Maritime Single-Window and Digital Customs Upgrade
item.description: Commerce officials and port authorities across Singapore, Mumbai, and Chennai unveiled coordinated investments to digitize bills of lading and expand container corridors linking India with Southeast Asia.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: WHO Expands Global Genomic Sequencing Grid to Track Drug-Resistant Hospital Pathogens
item.description: Reference laboratories across Europe, Africa, and Asia linked into a rapid WHO sequencing network capable of flagging emerging carbapenem-resistant infections within hours.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: North Sea Grid Operators Commission 18-Gigawatt Offshore Wind Interconnector Hub
item.description: Danish, Dutch, and German transmission utilities energized the first cross-border North Sea artificial energy hub links, routing deepwater wind power seamlessly across mainland European grids.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: UN Security Council Adopts Geneva Humanitarian Access and Reconstruction Framework
item.description: Multilateral envoys in Geneva finalized a UN-backed reconstruction and humanitarian corridor blueprint establishing supervised border monitoring and transparent donor escrow governance.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: European Regulators Enforce Open-Source Audit Standards Under Continental AI Governance Rules
item.description: Digital standards agencies across 40 partner jurisdictions led from Berlin unveiled unified open-benchmark audit pipelines for general-purpose neural models deployed in public healthcare and civic grids.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Gulf and Eastern Mediterranean Utilities Advance $15 Billion Clean Power Interconnector
item.description: Grid operators across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Cyprus, and Greece signed engineering and sovereign-financing accords for high-voltage subsea power cables exporting desert solar energy to Europe.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Orbital Radar Surveys Confirm Subsurface Water-Ice Basins Around Lunar South Pole
item.description: Multi-agency polar orbiter telemetry mapped extensive buried water-ice lenses inside permanently shadowed craters near Shackleton Crater, strengthening future lunar propellant and base planning.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Nairobi Climate Ministerial Finalizes Operational Rules for $100 Billion Loss and Damage Fund
item.description: Delegates from 130 nations meeting in Nairobi agreed on rapid-disbursement triggers allowing drought- and cyclone-hit nations to draw emergency recovery capital within days of disaster declarations.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Tokyo–Zurich Quantum Consortium Demonstrates 10,000-Kilometer Entangled Optical Relay
item.description: Japanese and Swiss quantum physicists maintained entanglement fidelity across 10,000 kilometers using a high-altitude optical repeater satellite, overcoming fiber-loss limits for global cryptography.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Sudan Power Utility Races to Restore Omdurman Grid After Drone Strikes Hit Al-Markhiyat Substation
item.description: Repeated drone strikes targeting Sudan’s strategic Al-Markhiyat substation north of Omdurman plunged residential neighborhoods and water-treatment stations across Khartoum State into darkness.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: WHO Prequalifies Dual mRNA Vaccine Showing 94% Efficacy Against Dengue and Chikungunya
item.description: The World Health Organization granted full prequalification to a thermostable single-shot dual mRNA vaccine targeting both dengue serotypes and chikungunya across tropical regions.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: World Athletics Ratifies Historic Sub-Two-Hour Open-Road Marathon Mark in Vienna
item.description: Athletics officials ratified a landmark 1:59:14 open-road marathon performance recorded along Vienna’s flat Prater Hauptallee loop under full competition pacing and anti-doping rules.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: UN Delegates in Geneva Adopt Binding Inspection Treaty for Autonomous Military Systems
item.description: Sixty-four signatory states at the Palais des Nations ratified an international inspection treaty mandating human command-loop accountability in lethal defense and critical energy infrastructure systems.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: European and Asian Chipmakers Break Ground on $28 Billion Photonic Foundry in Dresden
item.description: A European–Asian semiconductor consortium broke ground in Dresden on a 300mm silicon-photonics wafer fab designed to replace copper chip interconnects with optical laser waveguides.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: G10 Central Banks Expand Dollar and Euro Swap Lines to Steady Emerging-Market Debt
item.description: Central bank governors meeting at the Bank for International Settlements in Basel widened standing foreign-exchange swap facilities to insulate solvent emerging economies from dollar liquidity squeezes.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Antarctic Commission Expands Southern Ocean Marine Sanctuary to 2.4 Million Square Kilometers
item.description: Meeting in Hobart, members of the Commission for the Conservation of Antarctic Marine Living Resources approved new no-take protection zones around East Antarctica and the Weddell Sea.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: WHO Phase 3 Trial Data Confirms 88% Efficacy for Next-Generation Pan-Tuberculosis Vaccine
item.description: Late-stage clinical findings presented in Brazzaville showed 88% efficacy against pulmonary tuberculosis across high-burden cohorts—including multi-drug-resistant strains—paving the way for adult immunization.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Nordic and Baltic Coalition Deploys Integrated Sub-Surface Acoustic Defense Grid
item.description: Defense ministries across Finland, Sweden, Estonia, and regional Baltic partners activated Project SeaShield—a continuous seabed acoustic and optical sensor network guarding submarine power cables and pipelines.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: FIFA Mandates Global Free-to-Air Broadcast Access Across 180 Territories for 2027 Club Cup
item.description: In a decisive victory for supporters associations, FIFA’s executive congress embedded free-to-air terrestrial broadcast quotas into media rights contracts for its expanded 32-team club tournament.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: James Webb Telescope Confirms Nitrogen Atmosphere and Water Vapor on Temperate Exoplanet LHS 1140 b
item.description: Transmission spectroscopy from the James Webb Space Telescope’s NIRSpec instrument confirmed a secondary nitrogen-rich atmosphere with water-vapor signatures around rocky super-Earth LHS 1140 b.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)
